about: Files allowed to write colour literals outside client/src/styles/tokens.css (server/test/colour-literals.test.js). Each is an illustration with its own palette that reads on both themes: it is drawn on its own background, or was checked on the dark page (screenshots).

files.client/src/avatars/index.jsx: 16 avatar faces, always drawn on their own pastel disc (--avatar-*), which stays the same in both themes
files.client/src/components/Mascot.jsx: the otter, fox and lion: fur colours are the animals'; in the dark theme they stand on --mascot-backdrop
files.client/src/components/BadgeIcon.jsx: medals: a white glyph on a coloured medal with a darker ring, the same in both themes
files.client/src/components/Flag.jsx: the British, French and Dutch flags: their colours are fixed by the flags themselves
